name: incident.io
summary: incident.io has a free Basic plan with single-team on-call and a public status page. Team costs $15 per user a month on annual billing or $19 monthly, Pro costs $25, and on-call is a separate add-on at $10 per user on Team or $20 on Pro.

evidence.capability: alert routing to escalation paths and users
postmortem documents on Pro and Enterprise

facts.text: Alerts can be escalated to escalation paths, to users, or to a combination of both, and a query-based expression can pick the escalation path from the impacted service or team.
Multiple postmortem documents are included on the Pro and Enterprise plans, and not on Basic or Team.
A standalone on-call plan costs $20 per user a month, and the pricing page does not state its billing period.
The security page says incident.io is SOC 2 Type I and Type II and GDPR compliant. It does not mention ISO 27001 or HIPAA.
Status page subscribers can receive updates by email, Slack and RSS.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Single-team on-call, one public status page, and essential incident automation

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Billed annually; $19 on monthly billing. On-call is an add-on at $10 per user a month

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: The page does not state the billing period. On-call is an add-on at $20 per user a month. Includes SSO and SAML

plans.name: On-call only
plans.notes: Standalone on-call product; billing period not stated

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Includes SSO, SAML and SCIM

hiddenCosts: On-call is an add-on on Team and Pro, so a Pro responder with on-call costs $45 per user a month before discounts.
The pricing page does not state the billing period for Pro.
